meta.source: GENERATED from github.com/seenu-yellapu/schedulink-design by scripts/tokens.mjs. Edit the repo, not this file.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page background. Most of the site sits on this.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands. Never two sunken bands in a row.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. On light they need a line border to read, since there are no shadows.

tokens.name: surface-invert
tokens.usage: The footer, and nothing else on a page. The closing CTA stays white: two dark bands near each other makes the page bottom-heavy in a monochrome system.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The house dark. Headlines and primary text.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy and supporting paragraphs.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels, captions, metadata. Never body copy.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The ScheduLink blue, from the logo. Buttons, links, active states and the mark itself. Nothing decorative.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Link text on light grounds and primary button hover.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a positive status chip or an active nav item. Text on it is brand-strong.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Ground for anything that needs attention: a conflict flag, an overdue chip, a roster still outstanding. Neutral by design, with ink text and a 3px ink rule carrying the emphasis instead of a colour.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, section rules, table dividers. Structure comes from these, not from shadows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, secondary button outlines, focus rings.

tokens.name: page-grey
tokens.usage: The page ground. Sections float on it as white cards.

tokens.name: status-overdue-bg
tokens.usage: Overdue status pill background.

tokens.name: status-overdue-text
tokens.usage: Overdue status pill text.

tokens.name: status-today-bg
tokens.usage: Due-today status pill background. Purple is used for due-today only.

tokens.name: status-today-text
tokens.usage: Due-today status pill text.

tokens.name: status-later-bg
tokens.usage: Due-later status pill background.

tokens.name: status-later-text
tokens.usage: Due-later status pill text.

tokens.name: illus-rim
tokens.usage: Soft rim around product illustrations.

tokens.name: illus-rim-line
tokens.usage: Border of the soft rim.

tokens.name: illus-header-rule
tokens.usage: Line under column headers in product illustrations.

tokens.name: illus-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder lines and pills in simplified rows.

tokens.name: illus-shootcard
tokens.usage: Shoot card background in the Photographers column.

tokens.name: illus-shootcard-line
tokens.usage: Shoot card border.

tokens.name: illus-tile-line
tokens.usage: Border of the pale blue column-header tile in product illustrations. The tile itself is brand-soft.

tokens.name: symbol-line
tokens.usage: Border of the white tile behind a benefit symbol.

tokens.name: confirm
tokens.usage: The green tick badge on a benefit symbol. Shapes only, always with a tick, never text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a marker dot and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and between stacked list items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, gap between a heading and its eyebrow.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its paragraph.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and grid gutters on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding, top and bottom, on desktop and phones (Seenu, 2026-10-20: each section fits one laptop screen). Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Large gaps between blocks inside a section. No longer section padding: at 120px most sections did not fit one laptop screen.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Marker dots and tiny UI squares.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls inside product illustrations. Not buttons or tabs, which use radius-md. Chips and tags use 6px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Every button and tab.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Screenshot frames and large feature blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars and status dots only. Not buttons or tabs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Section cards on the grey page.

tokens.name: shadow-product
tokens.usage: Product images only: screenshots and interface fragments. Never on page sections, cards, buttons or panels.

tokens.name: shadow-product-lift
tokens.usage: The front-most layer in a stacked product image, such as the phone in the hero.
